from dataclasses import dataclass


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PublicRoute:
    pattern: str
    # When False, wildcards may not cross "/": the path must have the same depth as the pattern.
    spans_segments: bool = True


DEFAULT_ROUTES = (PublicRoute("/teams/*/badge.png", spans_segments=False),)

def test_team_badge_route_does_not_reach_nested_folders():

        "/teams/west/badge.png": b"PNG",
        "/teams/west/drafts/badge.png": b"draft",
